question: You want to know whether a diet is working, so you weigh yourself whenever you feel lighter. What have you measured?
answer: Choosing when to measure by how you feel makes the readings a record of your mood rather than your weight. A fixed schedule you cannot move is the whole difference between data and self-portraiture.
move: Decide when you will measure before you know what it will say.
trap: The measurement is triggered by the thing being measured.
